WHAT’S ON

ABOUT US

Brighton Music Hall, conveniently situated on Brighton's iconic beach, is the beating heart of Brighton’s beach scene, making it the perfect spot for a relaxing day out or a lively evening.

​

As the city's #1 outdoor, live music venue and restaurant, we offer a dining experience like no other, with the best sea views in Brighton. Our street food inspired menu, available every day from 10am.

We showcase the best live music Monday to Sunday from 11 am - late, making your meal a truly memorable one.

​

We boast the largest beach terrace in the UK, with covered spaces and FREE to hire private heated beach huts, with the option to add karaoke to your beach hut booking on request.

​

 Looking for a venue for your event? Our incredible upstairs bar and restaurant , has the best views in town, and is available for free private venue hire. We've been the backdrop for a wide range of events, from weddings and receptions to parties, launches, and corporate events, since 2010. 

​

Join us for beachfront dining, all-day live music and the ultimate sea side view.  

​

Please note - Times may vary.
